items.what: KeyBanc cut its rating from Overweight to Sector Weight and removed its price target
items.why: The publicly reported reason is the Democratic win in the Texas governor's race: the new governor campaigned on pausing new data centers, and Vistra is the most exposed of its peers. Earnings estimates barely moved this week: 2026 output is almost fully hedged and 2027 more than 90%, so what fell was the multiple (forward P/E from about 13x to about 12x). Most of the cut to 2027 EPS estimates came from August to early September, on softer Texas power prices and the August 3 pause on data-center grid approvals. Our November 6 zone already puts policy risk in the bear case, so no review for now.

items.what: 2027 EPS consensus up about 7% in 7 days as post-earnings revisions came through
items.why: The raises follow the October 28 report: revenue and EPS beat by a wide margin and full-year guidance was raised for the third time; at the Baird conference on November 10 management said demand is resilient, customers are not pushing back on higher prices, and adding capacity is the main constraint. Over the same stretch the stock sat about 15% below its post-earnings high, so the forward P/E on 2027 EPS fell from about 27x to about 21x; on November 11 JPMorgan resumed coverage at Neutral, with the publicly reported reason that AI-linked industrial valuations are exposed to slower spending. The new consensus (about $9.84) is still below the 2027 EPS in our base case (about $10.1), so this alone does not trigger a review; the zone was already marked for review.

items.what: Around Jensen Huang's resignation, more than ten firms including Baird, Bernstein, Evercore ISI and Truist cut their ratings to neutral; HSBC followed with a Hold on 11/13
items.why: The publicly reported reasons centre on leadership: on November 12 Huang resigned as CEO and director during an outside investigation commissioned by the board; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and no successor has been named. Some firms also cite talent retention, China export restrictions and slower growth in AI spending. Earnings estimates barely moved: consensus EPS for the next two fiscal years was roughly flat over 7 days and several firms kept their forecasts, so what fell was the multiple. A CEO exit could affect talent and execution, which may change the fundamentals, so we have put the zone under review.
